title: enform config.flow.title@1 event payload
description: The payload of a config.flow.title@1 event (#220, I14). The flow definition format has no title (schemas/flow/v2.json), so the title that the builder shows is one attributed configuration change beside the definition. The event names the flow by its slug and the title that the builder shows; a projection folds the newest title into the flow list, and a rebuild reproduces it from the log (I4).

flow.description: The slug of the flow whose title changed (ID-1).

title.description: The name that the builder shows for the flow (#220).
